725:t_007:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry. I know when to use the carrot and when to use the stick.」

725:t_007:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「As expected of the partner of the $$いがみ合う双子$$. You've mastered opposing elements.」

725:t_007:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But isn't that true of us as well, creating hope by acknowledging the despair within ourselves?」

725:t_007:19.en:
$n
(Using no way as the way, using the limitless as the limit... The teachings of Jeet Kune Do gave me the power to go beyond hope and despair, didn't they...)

725:t_007:20.en:
$n
(And that becomes the road to $$太極$$...!)

725:t_007:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「The real fight starts now! Get ready, you villains!」

725:t_007:23.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah, I know! Let's do this, Bro!」

725:t_009:0.en:
$$リーロン$$
「The $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ is complete!」

725:t_010:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Did you see that, Bro? This is $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$!」

725:t_010:1.en:
$$カミナ$$
「You bet, $$シモン$$! I got a good long look at how you live!」

725:t_010:5.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「How can you be here!?」

725:t_010:6.en:
$$カミナ$$
「What are you so surprised about? I'm immortal, at least in $$シモン$$'s heart.」

725:t_010:7.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I see. By turning his own past into power, the Spiral Man has given that man substance.」

725:t_010:8.en:
$$カミナ$$
「Well, only inside this $$天元突破グレンラガン#robot$$, though.」

725:t_010:11.en:
$$ニア$$
「Nice to meet you, Bro. I'm $$ニア$$, $$シモン$$'s wife.」

725:t_010:12.en:
$$カミナ$$
「Hey there, beautiful! Thanks for always being there for $$シモン$$!」

725:t_010:13.en:
$$カミナ$$
「From here on, I'm lending you my strength too!」

725:t_010:15.en:
$$カミナ$$
「Former leader of the unyielding, indomitable demons! With the great $$カミナ$$ here, you can rest easy!」

725:t_010:16.en:
$$カミナ$$
「...That's what I'd like to say, but $$シモン$$! I'm going to watch your power up close, right at your side!」

725:t_010:17.en:
$$カミナ$$
「I'm counting on you! Show me your power, the power I believed in, everyone believed in, and you believed in yourself!」
